ValidationRule.description: SAL-7666: Allow Agents to edit the Cohort Go ID field only when it's empty.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $RecordType.Name = "Agents", NOT($Profile.Name = "System Administrator"), NOT(ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(CohortGo_ID__c))), ISCHANGED(CohortGo_ID__c) ) && Acc_Val_Bypass__c = false
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This field cannot be modified if it has a value. Please contact your System Administrator.
